## What this changes and why

## Tests
- [ ] `npx eslint .` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] A behaviour change has a test that fails without it
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` run, if user-facing code changed

## Checks
- [ ] No new network request that sends page text, user data or usage data without disclosure
- [ ] No accuracy claim in code, comments or copy
